up: Select: [chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id, efo_term, mesh_id, mesh_heading, max_phase_for_ind] Source: [molecule_dictionary, drug_indication] Join: [molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno] Filter: [drug_indication.mesh_id IS NOT NULL AND drug_indication.mesh_heading IS NOT NULL AND molecule_dictionary.therapeutic_flag = 1 AND molecule_dictionary.oral = 1 AND molecule_dictionary.black_box_warning = 0 AND molecule_dictionary.withdrawn_flag = 0] Sort: [mesh_heading ASC, efo_term ASC] Limit: [None]
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT d.chembl_id AS chembl_id, d.pref_name AS name, s.canonical_smiles AS smiles, di.efo_id AS efo_id, di.efo_term AS indication, di.mesh_id AS mesh_id, di.mesh_heading AS indication_heading, di.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase_for_ind
FROM molecule_dictionary d
INNER JOIN drug_indication di ON d.molregno = di.molregno
INNER JOIN compound_structures s ON d.molregno = s.molregno
WHERE d.therapeutic_flag = 1
  AND d.oral = 1
  AND d.black_box_warning = 0
  AND d.withdrawn_flag = 0
  AND di.mesh_id IS NOT NULL
  AND di.mesh_heading IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY di.mesh_heading ASC, di.efo_term ASC;
